question: 我选修课和必修课分别有多少门？
sql: SELECT c.course_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS course_count FROM enrollment e JOIN teaching_class tc ON e.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id WHERE e.student_id = 1 GROUP BY c.course_type LIMIT 200

question: 我已完成课程的平均成绩是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(sc.final_score) AS avg_final_score FROM score sc JOIN enrollment e ON sc.enrollment_id = e.id WHERE e.student_id = 1 LIMIT 200

question: 各学院学生人数是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count FROM student s JOIN college c ON s.college_id = c.id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY student_count DESC

question: 2025 年春季学期挂科率最高的 5 门课程是什么？
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, AVG(CASE WHEN sc.final_score < 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS fail_rate, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollment_count FROM score sc JOIN enrollment e ON sc.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN teaching_class tc ON e.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id WHERE tc.year = 2025 AND tc.semester = 'spring' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 0 ORDER BY fail_rate DESC, enrollment_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 统计每位教师的授课班级数和选课学生人次。
sql: SELECT t.name AS teacher_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.id) AS teaching_class_count, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollment_count FROM teacher t JOIN teaching_class tc ON t.id = tc.teacher_id LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON tc.id = e.teaching_class_id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY teaching_class_count DESC, enrollment_count DESC

question: 哪些课程的平均分低于 70？
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, AVG(sc.final_score) AS avg_final_score, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollment_count FROM score sc JOIN enrollment e ON sc.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN teaching_class tc ON e.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(sc.final_score) < 70 ORDER BY avg_final_score ASC
